title: Embedded logic analyzer verification and trace decompression
summary: Trace-data decompression tooling and UVM debugging for a customer-shipped embedded logic analyzer.

facts.text: Created a script to decompress embedded logic analyzer trace data that was shipped to customers.
Tested and debugged an Arm Cortex-A CPU embedded logic analyzer using a UVM testbench.
The newer career outline reports developing and validating UVM testbench coverage models; the older source establishes testbench debugging but does not establish coverage-model authorship.

notes: Use UVM testbench debugging in application copy until coverage-model authorship is clarified. No programming language is inferred for the decompression script.
